gazette_location.description_raw_en: Road commencing at its junction with Clearwater Bay Road to the west of Lung Wo Tsuen and running in a south south-easterly direction for about 1,688 metres where it bends easterly for about 310 metres, then bends in a south-easterly direction for about 460 metres, then bends in a north-easterly direction for about 530 metres and then bends in a south-easterly direction for about 400 metres to terminate at Ma Yau Tong Village as shown coloured red on Drawing No. NTA/SK/R3.
gazette_location.description_raw_zh: 此道路由與位於龍窩村西面清水灣道之連接點開始，向東南偏南伸展約一千六百八十八米，轉向東伸展約三百一十米，然後轉向東南伸展約四百六十米，再轉向東北伸展約五百三十米，然後轉向東南伸展約四百米至馬遊塘村終止，見 NTA/SK/R3 號圖則塗紅色所示。
